# Medical Recovery
A [bold]medical recovery implant[/bold] brings its carrier's body back to the station. It works once; after it has fired it is spent.
Security Officers and Assistants start with one, and the implanter can be bought from the NanoMed Civilian vending machine.
There are three ways recovery starts. Each one takes about 6 seconds, is announced to Medical on the radio, and the body arrives on a recovery pad.
- [bold]Automatically[/bold] when the carrier dies away from the station map, for example on a shuttle or at an away site. The body goes to a pad on the station. - [bold]Recovery beacon:[/bold] use it in your hand. It locks onto the nearest [italic]dead[/italic] carrier within 90 tiles on the same map. - [bold]Recovery console:[/bold] click it. It recalls the nearest carrier who is [italic]critical or dead[/italic] within 90 tiles on the same map, to its own linked pad. The console links to the first pad on its grid, so build the pad on the same grid.
If there is no recovery pad on the station the implant is still spent, and Medical is told to notify an administrator.
